facts.fact: Organic law no. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the protection of personal data was promulgated, setting the general processing, consent and rights regime; the document's capture note of 3 September 2026 calls it the operative statute with no replacement adopted.

facts.fact: The law names and defines the national authority for personal data protection (the Instance, INPDP) and gives it the powers to receive declarations and to authorise processing and transfers; the document does not state that it has been constituted.

facts.fact: Draft organic law no. 095/2025 on the protection of personal data, 132 articles, was deposited before the Assembly of the Representatives of the People on 14 July 2025 and would repeal organic law no. 63 of 2004 six months after publication.

facts.fact: The Forum Chawki Gaddes, in a statement of 3 October 2026, cites organic law no. 63 of 2004 as the law guaranteeing personal data protection and says the legal framework of the data protection authority remains in force.

The Forum says the activities of the national personal data protection authority (INPDP) are at a standstill and calls for its reactivation, so no application by the authority is current; the date the activity stopped is not given.
